caption: The drawing depicts a square textile design composed primarily of red, dark blue, and white colors. The central feature is a white cross encircled by a ring of small white rectangles, all set against a dark blue background. Surrounding the central motif are blocks of solid red, arranged in a grid pattern, intersected by blue and red lines with circular and bar-shaped designs in white and light blue. The outer edges of the square feature alternating bands and zigzag patterns in red, white, and blue, and display short, fringe-like extensions in the same colors along the left, bottom, and right borders. The overall composition consists of repeating geometric forms, including squares, rectangles, circles, and chevrons, organized symmetrically within the bordered square. The drawing is centered on a plain, light tan background.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
